{{Quote|Caluula? In the Tion Hegemony? Could you have picked a more out-of-the-way planet?"|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TUF" />}}
'''Caluula''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that made up part of the [[Kingdom of Cron]] and later [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. After the empire's collapse, Caluula became part of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> Near the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] conquered the planet and sent many of its defenders to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for sacrifice. The planet was the site of a [[Battle of Caluula|battle]] between the Yuuzhan Vong and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TUF" />

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong occupying the world were themselves killed as the first test subjects of [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red]]. Despite assurances from its largely [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] creators that Alpha Red was harmless to all flora and fauna indigenous to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Vong-targeting virus mutated during its test deployment on Caluula and began to decimate the native flora and fauna, wiping out the planet's rare [[winged-star]] insects.<ref name="TUF" />

Attempts by the Galactic Alliance to quarantine the planet following the war failed, and emigrants were subject to stringent decontamination procedures.<ref name="Xim Week" />
